description: Unique-index failure. UPDATE T SET U = U + 1 (U = 101..104 under a unique index; the final state is unique, intermediate states may not be) through Database.Execute without options; then on T2 the sequence A = INSERT row 50, B = the same U + 1 update with dbFailOnError, C = INSERT row 51. Asks the return, RecordsAffected, Errors and the surviving rows of T and T2.
